title: Eval foundation and component detection
description:
Deliver the shared evaluation contracts, scoring engine, documentation, unit tests, and Layer 1 component adapter.

The finding contract must include canonical layer-specific identity, labels, normalized evidence, and exact scanned-file coverage. A location-only match is insufficient when multiple findings overlap one line.

Report recall, conditional label accuracy, correct-label recall, true precision only for exhaustively annotated scopes, negative-case pass rate, and unread counts separately. Do not average metrics.

Use a few committed fixtures to prove the machinery and component adapter. Known scanner misses may appear as benchmark data, but the Jest suite itself must pass. Assert expected results or regression thresholds rather than committing intentionally failing tests.

The component adapter reads scanResult.components with AI disabled and makes zero src changes. This PR proves the harness; it does not claim representative scanner quality. Do not create empty layer stubs.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Outside evaluator audit — metric contract is not stable yet

Target reviewed: feature/DATAP-602-eval-system at 937c3de, including component harness commit 38f749d. Targeted component + benchmark tests pass, but synthetic scorer checks expose correctness failures:

1. Identity-only matching ignores evidence. tests/eval/score.ts findFinding() matches only subject.key; sourceLines are never consulted. A finding for asset:db at line 99 satisfies ground truth for asset:db at line 1 and reports recall=1.
2. Unread cases affect denominators incorrectly. An unread positive is counted as an evaluable false negative; an unread negative is counted as a clean pass. Both contradict exact per-file unread handling.
3. documentedGap removes a confirmed positive from recall. The current psycopg2 miss therefore yields recall=1 with zero evaluable positives instead of remaining a measured miss. Keep known gaps in metrics and separate metric reporting from CI gating.
4. Precision keys are global across fixtures and evidence is ignored. A finding in fixture B can borrow a positive key defined only in fixture A and score as a true positive; the synthetic case produced precision=1 while recall=0.
5. Empty denominators return 1 for recall, label accuracy, and negative-case pass rate. These states are undefined and should be null or n/a, not perfect scores.
6. Fixture files are marked exhaustive by repeating exhaustiveScopeFiles on a handful of selected cases. Do not compute precision unless every legitimate component finding in that scope has accepted ground truth.

Please add direct scorer unit tests for wrong-line same-key findings, unread positive and negative cases, empty denominators, fixture-scoped precision matching, and documented known misses. DATAP-d61496 and DATAP-f3feec should remain blocked until these semantics are corrected; the current green integration test does not prove the shared contract.
